product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides banks with an AI-native core banking operating system for running banking services and deploying AI agents to automate workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The company description calls Maximum an AI-native operating system for banks and explains that banks can deploy custom agents to automate operational workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list no pricing link, and the attempted pricing URL did not return a pricing page. Under the requested rule, pricing_page is false.
